name: Man At Arms
source:
After five years of hard training in the school, you are finally a knight. Fight bandits, protect your village, rescue your loved ones, or do illegal things like kidnapping a princess. This game also has a combat system.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140910152213/http://renai.us/game/Man_at_arms.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
经过五年在学校的刻苦训练，你终于成为了一名骑士。打击强盗，保护你的村庄，拯救你所爱的人，或者做一些非法的事情，比如绑架公主。这个游戏还有战斗系统。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140910152213/http://renai.us/game/Man_at_arms.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
